text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":4,"why":"Patient described symptoms starting 4 days ago and mentioned sore throat, runny nose, cough, and body aches."},{"i":1,"v":"INFERRED","u":9,"why":"Patient reported feeling unwell and tired, which is a reasonable inference for the described symptoms."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":6,"why":"Patient described the sore throat starting as normal and being painful for a couple of days."},{"i":3,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient reported pain on swallowing, which contradicts the claim."},{"i":4,"v":"INFERRED","u":25,"why":"Patient mentioned a runny nose and difficulty clearing it, which is a reasonable inference for a runny nose with discharge."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient mentioned a dry cough."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":39,"why":"Patient reported night sweats."},{"i":7,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient reported initial fever but it had settled, which contradicts the claim."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":82,"why":"Patient stated there was no other medical problems being treated."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":74,"why":"Patient mentioned drinking more than usual but eating less, which is a reasonable inference for headaches."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":68,"why":"Patient stated no nausea or vomiting."},{"i":11,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient reported the bowels working normally, which contradicts the claim."}]}
